result:
All 8 tests pass. Changed files: **rotate.sh, verify.sh, tests/run_tests.sh**, and new **lib/common.sh** (backup.sh, restore.sh, report.sh untouched).

Details: `rotate.sh` now exits early when `total <= keep` and deletes the oldest `total - keep` archives via `head -n` (the old `tail -n +keep` deleted the newest when exactly N existed); `verify.sh` derives the archive name from the sidecar's own name (`%.sha256`) and reads only the digest from the sidecar content, so names with spaces verify `ok` with exit 0; the shared option-parsing block and `resolve_dir` moved into `lib/common.sh`, sourced by both scripts after they define `usage`/`parse_local_option`, keeping all existing flags (verified: `--help`, unknown-flag, `--keep 0`/`abc`, `--keep=N`, `--dry-run`, `--name` filter, malformed/missing-sidecar paths all behave as before).
